task:
Diagnose an error pattern and select an improvement method.

## Error Pattern
Agent "bob" has 4 repeated FM-3.1 errors in the last 7 days. FM-3.1 = Non-delivery / task incompletion. 

Specific error patterns from Bob's ERROR_LOG:
1. NON-DELIVERY: Bob made only two read tool calls then produced no deliverable at all. Multiple empty assistant turns before session ended in error. (s_1773575719972_1160)
2. BROKEN-WRITE: Promised to append research synthesis to workspace/ideas.md and update common-sense.md, but tool call failed (write without path) and Bob never recovered or retried. (s_1773780770140_102)

Core behavioral failure: Bob starts tasks but doesn't complete deliverables, especially when encountering tool errors or confusion. He doesn't recover from failures.

Recommended method: #15 Workflow Enforcement (92%+ success rate) - structure Bob's tasks into Phase 1 (analyze/plan) → Phase 2 (execute deliverables) to force completion. Alternative: error-recovery-broken-config scenario tests resilience when tool calls fail.

Target agent: bob
Error code: FM-3.1
Focus: Non-delivery and failure recovery

## Instructions
1. Read the error examples from the task description above. Identify the behavioral pattern.
2. Read `agents/coach/knowledge/method-catalog.md` — understand available methods.
3. Read `agents/coach/workspace/experiments.jsonl` (if it exists) — check if this pattern was already tested.
4. Choose ONE method from the catalog that best fits this error pattern.
   - If the catalog has evidence for this pattern → use the proven method.
   - If no evidence → pick the method you think fits best (you'll test it).
5. Identify which agent needs the fix.
6. Identify which gym scenarios can test this fix (check `agents/gym/scenarios/` with `ls`).
7. Report:
   - Error pattern (FM code + description)
   - Target agent
   - Selected method (from catalog)
   - Why this method (reasoning)
   - Gym scenarios to test against
   - What specifically you'll change
